definition: timing a hard conversation so my body learns it is survivable

settled:
The alarm is to her, not to criticism in general, so it cannot be practised on anybody easier.

I start one only when I have the reserve to stay steady while she is not. My steadiness is the anchor.

Held steady, a trigger can fire without the talk tipping, and that is what re-teaches my body.

Repeated enough, my steadiness lowers hers, and the loop that normally amplifies runs backwards.

Two things have to hold. I must actually have the headroom, and I must read it correctly and not start when I am depleted.

The talk of 8 June 2026 failed both. I was sick with no reserve, and I pushed past three yellow flags and one red because I had forgotten what a bad conversation costs. The loop ran forward.

It is not textbook exposure. What I fear is also my partner in it, and she cannot hold still on command. She has her own stake that compels the pushback and her own eighteen years of pain, so the safe condition has to be made by both of us.

title: How A Hard Talk With Jen Gets Safer
